source_of_truth.student_facing_note: Use the parent CLO language for syllabus and site materials unless the course design later decides to expose sub-CLOs.
source_of_truth.internal_note: Sub-CLOs are intended primarily for Canvas setup, assessment tracking, grader calibration, AI-assisted consistency checks, and future gamification.

performance_levels.name: No Evidence
performance_levels.description: No relevant evidence has been submitted or observed.

performance_levels.name: Attempted
performance_levels.description: Relevant work has been submitted, but the evidence is not yet on track toward full proficiency.

performance_levels.name: Developing
performance_levels.description: Evidence is on track, but full proficiency has not yet been demonstrated.

performance_levels.name: Proficient
performance_levels.description: Full proficiency has been demonstrated at an acceptable level for ASEN 3501.

performance_levels.name: Mastery
performance_levels.description: Full proficiency has been demonstrated consistently, clearly, independently, and with strong engineering judgment.

assessment_tracking.core_assessment_pass_rule: Every core assessment must receive a pass. A pass means every associated sub-CLO is at least Developing/on track for that assessment.
assessment_tracking.human_grader_workflow: Human graders assign 1-3 for every pertinent sub-CLO on an assessment and flag secondary review when there is reason to consider Mastery.
assessment_tracking.ai_use_note: AI evaluation may be used for coursewide consistency checks, but human graders retain responsibility for grading decisions.
assessment_tracking.mastery_review_trigger: Use a secondary review flag when evidence may warrant level 4 Mastery.

clos.title: Design and Conduct Aerospace Experiments
clos.statement: Design and conduct aerospace experiments by applying measurement fundamentals, instrumentation principles, and best practices in small team environments.

sub_clos.title: Design by Applying Measurement Fundamentals
sub_clos.description: Design aerospace experiments with appropriate attention to how measurement fundamentals affect the experiment design.

sub_clos.title: Conduct by Applying Measurement Fundamentals
sub_clos.description: Conduct aerospace experiments by taking measurements appropriately and understanding what measurement practice requires.

sub_clos.title: Design by Applying Instrumentation Principles
sub_clos.description: Design aerospace experiments with appropriate attention to how instrumentation choices affect the experiment and its defensible claims.

sub_clos.title: Conduct by Applying Instrumentation Principles
sub_clos.description: Conduct aerospace experiments while understanding how different instruments affect the experiment and what each instrument output means.

sub_clos.title: Small-Team Best Practices
sub_clos.description: Apply best practices in small team environments while planning, conducting, documenting, and communicating experimental work.

clos.title: Uncertainty and Confidence
clos.statement: Apply statistical methods and uncertainty analysis to quantify experimental error and establish confidence in results.

sub_clos.title: Quantify Experimental Uncertainty
sub_clos.description: Apply appropriate methods and analysis to quantify experimental uncertainty.

sub_clos.title: Establish Confidence in Results
sub_clos.description: Use uncertainty and statistical reasoning appropriately to establish confidence in experimental results.

clos.title: Models and Data
clos.statement: Integrate theoretical models with experimental data to validate and evaluate aerospace system behavior.

sub_clos.title: Validate Models with Data
sub_clos.description: Integrate theoretical models with experimental data to evaluate whether a model is valid for its intended use.

sub_clos.title: Evaluate Aerospace System Behavior
sub_clos.description: Use models and experimental data together to evaluate and explain aerospace system behavior.

clos.title: Signal Conditioning, Sampling, and DAQ
clos.statement: Implement signal conditioning, sampling, and data acquisition techniques to ensure accurate experimental measurements.

sub_clos.title: Signal Conditioning
sub_clos.description: Explain and apply how signal conditioning influences accurate experimental measurement.

sub_clos.title: Sampling
sub_clos.description: Explain and apply how sampling choices influence accurate experimental measurement.

sub_clos.title: Data Acquisition
sub_clos.description: Explain and apply how data acquisition choices influence accurate experimental measurement.

clos.title: Technical Communication
clos.statement: Communicate experimental results effectively through technical reports and presentations, with clear description of methods, results, and limitations.

sub_clos.title: Written Communication
sub_clos.description: Communicate experimental methods, results, limitations, and defensible conclusions effectively in written technical reports.

sub_clos.title: Oral Communication
sub_clos.description: Communicate experimental methods, results, limitations, and defensible conclusions effectively in oral presentations.

clos.title: Independent Experimental Methods
clos.statement: Identify, evaluate, and create experimental methods or instrumentation beyond those provided by the instructor to foster independent professional growth.

sub_clos.title: Identify Methods Beyond Those Provided
sub_clos.description: Identify experimental methods or instrumentation beyond those provided by the instructor.

sub_clos.title: Evaluate Methods Beyond Those Provided
sub_clos.description: Evaluate experimental methods or instrumentation beyond those provided by the instructor.

sub_clos.title: Create Methods Beyond Those Provided
sub_clos.description: Create or synthesize experimental methods or instrumentation beyond those provided by the instructor.
